newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Train stranded in Australian outback.
newsitem.headline: Train stranded in Australian outback.

text.p: Passengers on Australia's outback rail service, The Ghan, were stranded overnight in the remote outback after engine failure during the trip from Alice Springs to Adelaide, Australian National said Wednesday.
A spokesman for the national rail service said The Ghan, carrying 137 passengers, had broken down near the small community of Kulgera, about 300 km south of Alice Springs, on Tuesday evening.
A replacement engine and two food vans had been sent to the remote location, the spokesman said.
The train resumed service on Wednesday morning and was expected to arrive in Adelaide, about 20 hours late, early on Thursday, he said.
